changes.title: Saved-query Sort menu crash
changes.text: Opening Sort no longer crashes when a saved query contains more than eight sort keys.

changes.title: Large sort-key regression
changes.text: Android checks now open the Sort menu with nine distinct public keys and capture it without dropping the query's keys.

changes.title: Source-reviewed audit evidence
changes.text: Recorded exact reviewed source files, cache and filter evidence, and a reproduced saved-query crash.

changes.title: Developer Commentary
changes.text: I removed an unused array that could crash the Sort menu for a larger saved query. Sorting and saved-query formats remain unchanged.
